title: The school concert
instructions: Müzik öğretmeni velilere okul konserini anlatıyor. Tarih, saat, yer ve fiyatlara dikkat et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Hello, parents. This is Mr Davies, the music teacher.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Our school concert is on Friday the eighteenth of December.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: It isn't in the school hall this year. It's in the church next to the school, because the hall is too small.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: The concert starts at six o'clock, but please come at half past five.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Children must wear white shirts and black trousers or skirts.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Tickets are three pounds for adults. Children under five are free.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: After the concert, there are drinks and cakes in the school hall.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Thank you, and see you there!
